finding: Broker release/conflict resolution can leave multiple opposing reservation artifacts for the same shared path without a supersession or last-writer contract, so `resolve` may report ready while later close/preclose sees the conflict again.
expectedBehavior: Reservation resolution artifacts should have a formal supersession interface with a single authoritative release order per conflict set, or close should consume a deterministic latest valid artifact and explain why older artifacts are ignored.
evidenceOrRepro: TASK-AAO-0206 and TASK-RFT-0101 shared `atom-cli-router`: `BCR-2ki403.json` selected TASK-AAO-0206 as primary while existing `BCR-snim65.json` selected TASK-RFT-0101 as primary. The agent observed `ATM_TEAM_BROKER_CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_READY`, then close surfaced the broker conflict again.
followUp: Implement formal reservation supersession and add close/preclose regression coverage for opposing artifacts on the same shared atom/path.
